# ScrollBox { #anylumino.ScrollBox }

```python
ScrollBox(
    widgets=None,
    *,
    titles=None,
    keys=None,
    spacing=8,
    stretches=None,
    width='100%',
    height=420,
    resizable=True,
    scroll=True,
    scroll_x=None,
    scroll_y=None,
    child_min_width=None,
    child_min_height=None,
)
```

Scrollable vertical box for notebook-sized control panels.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type                     | Description                                                        | Default   |
|------------------|--------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| widgets          | iterable or mapping      | Child widgets or keyed child mapping.                              | `None`    |
| titles           | iterable or mapping      | Optional labels associated with children.                          | `None`    |
| keys             | iterable of str          | Stable child keys for iterable ``widgets``.                        | `None`    |
| spacing          | int                      | Pixel spacing between children.                                    | `8`       |
| stretches        | iterable of int          | Lumino stretch factors, one per child when provided.               | `None`    |
| width            | int, float, str, or None | Widget width. Numeric values use the shared anylumino size rules.  | `'100%'`  |
| height           | int, float, str, or None | Widget height. Numeric values use the shared anylumino size rules. | `420`     |
| resizable        | bool                     | Whether the panel receives a notebook-friendly resize handle.      | `True`    |
| scroll           | bool                     | Enables vertical scrolling by default.                             | `True`    |
| scroll_x         | bool                     | Explicit horizontal or vertical overflow controls.                 | `None`    |
| scroll_y         | bool                     | Explicit horizontal or vertical overflow controls.                 | `None`    |
| child_min_width  | int, float, str, or None | Minimum child sizes used when scrolling is enabled.                | `None`    |
| child_min_height | int, float, str, or None | Minimum child sizes used when scrolling is enabled.                | `None`    |
